cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

mechanism: A copies apparent workshop expertise while pressing B to acknowledge dependence on A's help.
confusable: S03 asserts actual expertise; S04 must visibly misunderstand and copy confidence without confessing confusion.
comparison: Useful physical assistance contrasts with an event role reduced to carrying.
seedUse: Use cupboard/help admission from D01-a and mistaken confident imitation from S04-a/b.
